name: graphops-rpc
description: Read EVM and Bitcoin chain data with GraphOps RPC: query blocks, balances, contract calls and event logs through the RPC MCP server, and write bounded, recoverable JSON-RPC code.

rpc_api_key.title: GraphOps RPC API key
rpc_api_key.description: A RPC key from API keys in the GraphOps platform. It is stored in your system's credential store and sent only to the GraphOps RPC MCP server.
